description: React component ChangeMultipleMenu responsible for rendering and managing a menu to change multiple notes' types or editors, including user confirmation dialogs for sensitive actions, and integration with application components and hooks.

methods.name: getGroupId
methods.description: Generates a lowercased, hyphen-separated ID from a menu group title.

methods.name: selectComponent
methods.description: Changes a note's editor component, clearing conflicts if needed.

methods.name: selectNonComponent
methods.description: Changes a note's type without specifying an editor component.

methods.name: selectItem
methods.description: Handles the selection of a menu item, including checks for entitlements and confirmation steps.

methods.name: closeCurrentSuperNoteImporter
methods.description: Removes the super note importer dialog, progressing through queued notes.

methods.name: handleSuperNoteConversionCompletion
methods.description: Completes the conversion of a super note and moves to the next queued note.
